newsitem.title: UK: BAA August passengers hit record 10 million.
newsitem.headline: BAA August passengers hit record 10 million.

text.p: UK airport operator BAA Plc said on Thursday that a record of almost 10 million passengers had passed through its seven UK airports in August, 4.5 percent more than in last August.
The group also noticed that cargo tonnage rose 6.6 percent against the same month last year to 117,881 tonnes.

BAA said all key market sectors except European charter flights had seen growth. Long haul and North Atlantic markets were up eight and six percent respectively, while Irish traffic continued its strong growth trend with a 15 percent rise in August, BAA said.
Stansted and Edinburgh airports saw the fastest growing passenger traffic -- up 22 and 21 percent respectively.
Strong performances on all major scheduled routes at Gatwick airport counteracted the declined of charter traffic, resulting in a net increase of 6.4 percent passengers.
